card.line: Seirah was a wooded region in the hill country of Ephraim where Ehud fled after killing King Eglon and then gathered Israel to fight Moab.

moments.title: Ehud escapes to Seirah
moments.text: While Eglon's servants waited outside the locked doors, Ehud got away. He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.

moments.title: Ehud blows the ram's horn
moments.text: On arriving in Seirah, Ehud blew the ram's horn throughout the hill country of Ephraim. The Israelites came down with him, and he became their leader.
